text: Run multiple coding agents concurrently on one repo, each in its own isolated Git worktree and branch
quote: Run several coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or any CLI agent) at the same time on one repository without them stepping on each other. Each agent gets an isolated Git worktree and its own branch.

text: Programmatically orchestrate agents via an MCP server: create workspaces, launch agent sessions, open terminals, schedule automations, manage tasks
quote: Superset MCP server: create Git-worktree workspaces, launch coding-agent sessions, schedule automations, open terminals, and manage tasks on behalf of a Superset user.

text: Schedule recurring agent runs (automations) on a cron-like schedule
quote: Schedule recurring agent runs (automations) that execute a prompt on a cron-like schedule in a fresh or existing workspace.

text: View a diff of exactly what an agent changed in a Changes tab
quote: Open each workspace's **Changes** tab to see exactly what its agent did.

text: Stage, commit, push, and create a pull request directly from the diff viewer
quote: stage, commit, push, and **Create PR**, all from the diff viewer.

text: Works with many different coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, etc.)
quote: Any agent: Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, and more

text: Official CLI to manage workspaces, tasks, automations, and the local host server from terminal or CI
quote: Use it to manage workspaces, tasks, automations, and the local host server from your terminal or from CI.

text: Official TypeScript SDK to create and manage workspaces, tasks, projects, and automations from code
quote: The Superset TypeScript SDK lets you create and manage your workspaces, tasks, projects, and automations from code.

text: Includes a 'computer' skill teaching agents to operate native desktop apps via an accessibility-first driver
quote: Superset includes a `computer` skill that teaches agents to operate native desktop applications through an accessibility-first driver.

text: Get notified when an agent finishes a task or pauses waiting for input
quote: Finished / waiting for input: get notified when an agent finishes or pauses for your input.

text: Select an element in a live design preview and send the requested change to an agent with element context
quote: Use **Design** in the browser pane to select an element and send your requested change to an agent with element context.

text: Select lines in a PR diff and send feedback to a running or new agent session
quote: Open **Pull requests → Code**, select diff lines, and send feedback to a running or new agent session.

text: Run and monitor agents from your phone
quote: Run your agents from your phone.

text: Share agent-created designs and reports with your team and turn comments into follow-up updates
quote: Share agent-created designs and reports with your team, and turn comments into updates

text: Fan out a refactor or migration across multiple worktrees, running an independent worker agent on each slice
quote: Fan out a refactor or migration across several worktrees at once ("split this migration into independent slices and run a worker on each")

text: Local-first architecture: works offline and syncs when connected; code stays on your machine unless you choose otherwise
quote: Superset is local-first: it works offline and syncs when connected. Your code never leaves your machine unless you say so.

text: Each task runs in its own Git worktree/branch, though this isolates files only and does not sandbox processes
quote: Each task runs in its own Git worktree and branch. Worktrees separate working files, but do not sandbox processes or prevent merge conflicts.

text: Prompt-first flow: describe the task, pick an agent, and the agent starts working immediately
quote: In the prompt-first flow, describe the task, pick an agent, and create. The agent starts working on your prompt immediately.

text: Add a repo from a local folder or clone a remote repo, searching GitHub repos via the host's GitHub CLI login
quote: Add your repo from a local folder or clone a remote repository. In the clone dialog, search the GitHub repositories available to the selected host's GitHub CLI login

text: Automations produce a live workspace that a teammate can open, review, and continue interactively
quote: Automations run an agent session against a project on a schedule, like a cron job, but the output is a live workspace you (or a teammate) can open, review, and continue interactively.

text: Running agents and their open ports are shown inline on the workspace item for quick status checks
quote: Running agents and open ports appear inline on the workspace item

text: Script bulk task management: creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks across one or many projects
quote: Bulk task management: script the creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks across one or many projects.

text: An 'orchestrate' skill lets one agent coordinate multiple worker agents in separate workspaces via the CLI
quote: The `superset:orchestrate` skill lets one agent coordinate workers in separate workspaces through the Superset CLI.

text: Dashboard to review diffs, manage ports, and monitor many concurrent agent sessions at once
quote: Review diffs, manage ports, and monitor many concurrent agent sessions from one dashboard.

text: Paid plan adds unlimited users, remote access, and automations for org-wide use
quote:
Everything in Free
*   Unlimited users
*   Remote access
*   Automations

text: CLI ships as a single static binary that drives the same backend as the desktop app
quote: The Superset CLI (`superset`) is a single static binary that drives the same backend as the desktop app.

text: Run agents in a combined workspace with terminals, code review, and browser previews together
quote: Run Claude Code, Codex, or another CLI agent with terminals, code review, and browser previews in one workspace.
